lemmas.name: K_LINEAR_CHANGE_OF_BASIS

lemmas.name: RATIONAL_SIMILITUDE_IN_EVEN_K_RANK

lemmas.name: DUALITY
lemmas.formula: det(H^{-1})=det(H)^{-1}; [d]^{-1}=[d] because d^2=N_{K/Q}(d) for d in Q^*
lemmas.consequence: duality does not change the discriminant class in the quotient
